kicker: Anatomy, a skill that draws machines

scenes.headline: How one line becomes a working machine
scenes.sub: Anatomy turns a request into a live isometric figure.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gimbal! Anatomy is a skill for Claude Code. You type one line, and Claude builds a working machine that explains the idea.

scenes.text: Don't draw boxes and arrows. Invent a real object whose working is the concept, and build it from many small solid parts.
scenes.say: The rule at the top: don't draw boxes and arrows. Invent a real object whose working is the concept.

left.title: Boxes and arrows
left.say: A diagram says the parts exist, and leaves the motion to you.

right.title: The object
right.say: Anatomy draws temperature as a roulette wheel. Each pocket is as wide as a token's probability.

scenes.title: The order Claude works in
scenes.say: The order of work is fixed.

items.say: Put the real numbers in a small model.
Invent the object, and list at least forty parts.
Build the solids once and paint them far to near.
Then check every joint, zoomed in.

scenes.title: From plans to a painted figure

steps.say: Claude never writes a mesh. It writes numbers: floor outlines, heights and radii.
The kit lifts each outline into a prism and shades each side in one of four tones.
With no depth buffer, parts are painted far to near, and an audit checks the order.
Fire, water and plasma go in a shader layer in the same camera, and it all sits in a card.

scenes.title: Solids and a shader, one camera

steps.say: Here is the Raptor engine example. The engine and stand are solid parts.
The plume is a shader, so the stand's posts can pass in front of the flame.

scenes.label: Claude's active time for the turbofan figure
scenes.note: first build 4 h 41 min, then five fix rounds
scenes.say: It isn't quick. The turbofan took fourteen hours of Claude's active time, most of it in review rounds.

scenes.text: Give the model a small vocabulary a kit can check, and it can build what it cannot see.
scenes.say: Give the model a small vocabulary a kit can check, and it can build what it cannot see.

recap: Draw the object, not a diagram
Solids from plans, painted in order
Checks that end in a number
scenes.say: Draw the object. Build solids from plans. Check with numbers.
